test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

We must __prayed at__ the Almighty for the well-being of all family members.
solution: The correct answer is 'pray to'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The error lies incorrect usage of the second form of the verb after the modal verb must. • The modal verb must is used to express obligation and necessity and it is usually followed by an infinitive without ‘to’. • Example: • I must stop smoking. It’s really bad for my health. • Thus, 'pray to' will be used in place of 'prayed'. Correct sentence:__ We must pray to the Almighty for the well-being of all family members. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Modal verb:** an auxiliary verb that expresses necessity or possibility. **Hinglish Answer:** सही उत्तर 'pray to' है। [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** __ • Modal verb **must **के बाद त्रुटि 2nd form of verb का गलत उपयोग है। • Modal verb **must **का उपयोग अनिवार्यता (obligation) और आवश्यकता (necessity) को व्यक्त करने के लिए किया जाता है और इसके बाद आमतौर पर infinitive बिना ‘to’ आता है। • **उदाहरण**: I must stop smoking. It’s really bad for my health. • इस प्रकार, 'prayed' की जगह 'pray to' का उपयोग किया जाएगा। **सही वाक्य**: We must pray to the Almighty for the well-being of all family members. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Modal verb: एक auxiliary verb जो अनिवार्यता या संभाव्यता को व्यक्त करता है। 1e9:Tc4c, The correct answer is **'****He worked so hardly****'**, i.e. the error lies in this part of the sentence.
